meta.title: Afonso Silva | Full-stack developer
meta.description: Afonso Silva is a full-stack developer in Madeira, Portugal, working with .NET, Vue and Nuxt. Former professional musician.

hero.name: Afonso Silva
hero.pitch: I build careful, well-tuned software for the web and beyond, from Madeira.

about.heading: About
paragraphs: I spent years as a professional musician, where timing, listening and attention to detail were the whole job. I still hear most things as a mix: every part needs room, and nothing should be louder than it has to be.

Today I work as a full-stack developer, mostly with .NET and Vue. I like systems that are clear to use and calm to maintain, and I enjoy the moments where my audio background and my code end up in the same project.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of things I have built or am building.

items.summary: A website with a custom content management system, built with Vue 3 and .NET.
A website designed and built end to end in Vue.
Personal headphone mixes for RME TotalMix FX, controlled from each musician's phone through a QR code. Runs as an offline desktop app.
A remote for monitor and headphone mixes with faders, snapshots and live OSC feedback.
A personal humidity and temperature monitor in a 3D-printed housing.
A small site in five languages with restrained motion.
